properties.name: TRUGS_PROTOCOL
properties.purpose: The TRUGS specification — 7 boundaries, 10 primitive classes, 16 validation rules, domain branches, JSON schema

properties.name: TRUGS_PROTOCOL/CORE.md
properties.purpose: The universal foundation — 7 boundaries, 10 semantic primitive classes (~140 primitives), composition rules, 16 validation rules

properties.name: TRUGS_PROTOCOL/BRANCHES.md
properties.purpose: Domain-specific vocabularies — CODE, Web, Writer, Knowledge (including Living and Research), and Nested branches with node types and edge relations

properties.name: TRUGS_PROTOCOL/SCHEMA.md
properties.purpose: JSON schema reference — formal field definitions, types, constraints for nodes and edges

properties.name: TRUGS_PROTOCOL/SPEC_fundamentals.md
properties.purpose: Gentle introduction to CORE concepts — minimal valid TRUG, required fields, hierarchy, dimensions

properties.name: TRUGS_PROTOCOL/SPEC_validation.md
properties.purpose: Structural validation rules with implementations; compositional rules are specified in CORE.md

properties.name: TRUGS_LANGUAGE
properties.purpose: TRL specification — 233-word vocabulary across 9 parts of speech, BNF grammar, 30 parsed examples, self-defining TRUG

properties.name: TRUGS_LANGUAGE/SPEC_vocabulary.md
properties.purpose: 233 words across 9 parts of speech (8 from computation/law plus 21 SI level prefixes added in 2.0) — every word defined with source and CORE status

properties.name: TRUGS_LANGUAGE/SPEC_grammar.md
properties.purpose: BNF grammar, composition rules, 12 validation rules for TRL sentences

properties.name: TRUGS_LANGUAGE/SPEC_examples.md
properties.purpose: 30 parsed examples across 13 patterns — each sentence decomposed into subject, modal, verb, object

properties.name: TRUGS_LANGUAGE/language.trug.json
properties.purpose: The opening TRUG — the language defining itself as a graph

properties.name: TRUGS_LANGUAGE/README.md
properties.purpose: Language overview — what TRL is, how sentences compile to graphs

properties.name: EXAMPLES
properties.purpose: 7 domain examples — knowledge, living, memory, nested, research, web, writer — all validate against CORE

properties.name: tools
properties.purpose: Build the language graph and generate paper counts, with test suites for the generators.

properties.name: tools/folder.trug.json
properties.purpose: Describe sixteen public functions and two dataclasses in the paper tools and their test fixtures.

properties.name: tools/__init__.py
properties.purpose: Package marker for the tools/ build-script package.

properties.name: tools/build_language_trug.py
properties.purpose: Parse SPEC_vocabulary.md into language.trug.json — 233 words, 289 nodes.
properties.trl: PROCESS builder SHALL MAP ALL RECORD word TO RECORD graph.

properties.name: tools/build_language_trug.py
properties.purpose: Parse vocabulary Markdown tables into ordered word records with their part of speech, subcategory, definition and core flag.

properties.name: tools/build_language_trug.py
properties.purpose: Assemble the language graph from parsed word records, preserving vocabulary order and grouping words by part of speech and subcategory.

properties.name: tools/build_language_trug.py
properties.purpose: Read command arguments, parse the vocabulary file and write the generated language graph; return a failure status when the arguments are invalid.

properties.name: tools/test_build_language_trug.py
properties.purpose: Tests for build_language_trug.py — 7 tests covering count math, contiguity, PoS distribution, definitions, keywords, ID uniqueness, and generated-file freshness.
properties.trl: PROCESS test SHALL VALIDATE PROCESS builder SUBJECT_TO DATA spec.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Measure paper listings, whole graphs, tagged annotations and numbered examples through the selected trug executable; write their counts as TeX macros.
properties.trl: PROCESS paper_measurement SHALL READ FILE paper AND FILE examples THEN PRODUCE DATA counts.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Store a label, source bytes and whether an exact round trip is required in a frozen data record.
properties.trl: RECORD case CONTAINS DATA label AND DATA text AND DATA exact_round_trip.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Store compilation, validation and byte comparison outcomes in a frozen data record.
properties.trl: RECORD result CONTAINS DATA accepted AND DATA valid AND DATA round_trip.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Extract trugs-style listing bodies in order, preserving their bytes and assigning sequential labels.
properties.trl: FUNCTION extract_listings SHALL FILTER DATA text THEN RETURN ALL RECORD listing.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Extract json-style listing bodies as whole graph cases in document order.
properties.trl: FUNCTION extract_graphs SHALL FILTER DATA text THEN RETURN ALL RECORD graph.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Extract tagged listing annotations, reject unpaired or nested tags, strip recognized comment leaders and mark inline annotations for exact comparison.
properties.trl: FUNCTION extract_annotations SHALL FILTER DATA text THEN RETURN ALL RECORD annotation.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Remove opening and closing TRL tag lines at the fence boundaries while preserving the other payload bytes.
properties.trl: FUNCTION strip_trl_tags SHALL FILTER DATA payload THEN RETURN DATA text.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Extract one fence per numbered heading, remove boundary TRL tags, preserve labels and reject missing or multiple fences and duplicate numbers.
properties.trl: FUNCTION extract_examples SHALL FILTER DATA text THEN RETURN ALL RECORD example.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Run a command with captured output and bytecode writing disabled, returning its completed process without requiring a zero exit status.
properties.trl: FUNCTION run_command SHALL EXECUTE PROCESS command THEN RETURN RECORD result.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Read the selected console script interpreter from its shebang and query that interpreter for the installed package version.
properties.trl: FUNCTION tool_version SHALL READ FILE executable THEN RETURN DATA version.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Compile source bytes, validate the resulting graph and compare decompiled bytes with the source; return the three outcomes and raise on decompilation failure.
properties.trl: FUNCTION check_case SHALL EXECUTE PROCESS compilation THEN VALIDATE RECORD graph AND RETURN RECORD result.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Write a whole graph listing unchanged, invoke graph validation and report whether it exits successfully and prints VALID.
properties.trl: FUNCTION check_graph SHALL VALIDATE RECORD graph THEN RETURN DATA valid.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Aggregate extracted examples and tool outcomes into string macro values; reject mismatched example and result lengths.
properties.trl: FUNCTION count_macros SHALL MAP ALL RECORD result TO DATA macros THEN RETURN DATA macros.

properties.name: tools/check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Measure required paper inputs with the selected trug executable, print outcomes, write TeX counts and return a status derived from the measured failures.
properties.trl: FUNCTION main SHALL READ FILE paper AND FILE examples THEN WRITE FILE counts AND RETURN DATA exit_code.

properties.name: tools/paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Count vocabulary word properties from the language graph and write the paper vocabulary macros.
properties.trl: PROCESS vocabulary_counting SHALL READ FILE language_trug THEN PRODUCE DATA macros.

properties.name: tools/paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Count word-key presence in root category order, treating empty sources as shared, rounding source percentages half up and marking empty category-source cells with dashes.
properties.trl: FUNCTION vocabulary_macros SHALL MAP RECORD language TO DATA macros THEN RETURN DATA macros.

properties.name: tools/paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Render the supplied macro mapping as TeX commands in mapping order with a generated-file header.
properties.trl: FUNCTION render_macros SHALL MAP DATA macros TO DATA text THEN RETURN DATA text.

properties.name: tools/paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Read the language graph, derive vocabulary macros, write the generated TeX file and print the values.
properties.trl: FUNCTION main SHALL READ FILE language_trug THEN WRITE FILE vocab_counts.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Test extraction, subprocess outcomes, selected interpreter metadata and generated counts using synthetic inputs.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE MODULE check_paper_trl.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Create an executable subprocess fixture that simulates compilation, graph validation and decompilation outcomes.
properties.trl: FUNCTION fake_trug SHALL WRITE FILE executable THEN RETURN DATA path.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check that only trugs-style listings are extracted with body bytes and ordering preserved.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA listing_styles_and_body_bytes.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check numbered example labels, unrelated fence exclusion and missing-fence and duplicate-number errors.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA numbered_examples_and_fence_errors.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check annotation payloads, comment leader removal, inline comparison flags and malformed tag errors across listing languages.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA annotation_payloads_and_tag_errors.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check compilation rejection, graph invalidity, byte comparison differences and decompilation errors with the subprocess fixture.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA compilation_validation_and_byte_comparison.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check that the version query invokes the selected console script interpreter.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA selected_interpreter_version_query.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check example, listing and graph macro counts and the exit status for accepted, invalid and changed listing inputs.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA listing_counts_and_exit_status.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check whole graph extraction, fragment exclusion, validity counts and the resulting exit status.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA whole_graph_counts_and_exit_status.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check that an empty rejected-example list is rendered as none.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA empty_rejection_list.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check annotation counts, inline comparison requirements, difference reporting and exit statuses for simulated tool outcomes.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA annotation_counts_and_exit_status.

properties.name: tools/test_check_paper_trl.py
properties.purpose: Check boundary TRL tag removal and preservation of untagged payloads.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA example_tag_removal.

properties.name: tools/test_paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Test vocabulary counting, rounding, empty-input rejection and repeatable TeX generation on synthetic language graphs.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE MODULE paper_vocab_counts.

properties.name: tools/test_paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Build a synthetic language graph with deliberately misleading stored counts and eight word-property records.
properties.trl: FUNCTION fixture_language SHALL PRODUCE RECORD language THEN RETURN RECORD language.

properties.name: tools/test_paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Check totals, version, verb groups and macro ordering from word properties and root categories.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA word_counts_and_category_order.

properties.name: tools/test_paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Check shared and empty sources, dash values for empty cells and half-up percentage rounding.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA shared_sources_empty_cells_and_rounding.

properties.name: tools/test_paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Check that a graph without word records raises the expected error.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA empty_vocabulary_error.

properties.name: tools/test_paper_vocab_counts.py
properties.purpose: Check repeatable generated bytes, selected macro values and output messages across two runs.
properties.trl: AGENT SHALL VALIDATE DATA repeated_generation_bytes_and_messages.

properties.scope: CORE defines the universal foundation all other specs build on
Domain vocabularies built on CORE structure
JSON schema formalizing CORE field definitions
233 words drawn from CORE primitives plus 21 SI level prefixes
Self-defining TRUG uses vocabulary words as nodes
All examples validate against CORE rules
Tests parse_spec + build_trug across SPEC_vocabulary.md as the source of truth.
STANDARD operationalizes the four-corner square defined in the PAPER
HOW paper derives from §5 of the Dark Code paper
